**New here:** water and the Bottle-Cap Raft; heat (hot burners); the first beetle sneak section. Decoy: the creaky fridge.

## Main path (Jump 2 / Speed 2: steps <= 2 tiles up, gaps <= 3 tiles)

1. kit-fridge (start, save 1) from the stair foot. Fridge creak decoy; thermostat lock for later.
2. kit-stove: hot burners (^ on solid ground), cockroaches; floor left to the cabinet under the sink.
3. kit-undersink: the Raft in the leak puddle; sound hole = the cracked drain pipe.
4. Back to kit-stove, climb onto kit-counter: save 2 + Ready card -> kit-sink (Big Tok).
5. After Duo: the window sill opens (kit-window) -> drop to kit-table (beetle sneak) -> kit-pantrydoor (raft the spill) -> Pantry (left) or Laundry (down).

## Notes

- The west half is reachable only through the lair until the dishwasher shortcut (one-way rungs on its west face, drop on the east) is used from the west.
- Both exits west (Pantry door, laundry stair head) are exact links: see links.md.
- Backtracking: cabinet tops (band), range hood glide (glider), dark kick-plate crawl (glow), thermostat lock (Frost), beetle lane (cloak), Mote crack.

### kit-fridge: The Fridge

Cell 14,6, 2x3 screens (64x54 tiles). Purpose: start, save, thermostat, secret, recruit, notCricket.

Zone start: save crack 1 on the floor by the doorway (right, y 8, from the stair foot). The fridge hums and creaks (decoy: "creaky fridge"). Its side is # (wall-jump) up to the fridge top (y 6): cookie jar crumb cache. Under the fridge (floor, left part): the drip tray (water) with Rolo the pill bug behind it (Raft). Thermostat lock (Frost): the condenser grille at the bottom blows warm, the freezer door seal at the top leaks cold; the lock on the side panel wants 66°F.

### kit-stove: The Stove

Cell 12,7, 2x2 screens (64x36 tiles). Purpose: traversal.

The oven front and the stovetop. New: heat. The glowing burner rings on the stovetop (y 7 top) are hot tiles (^, 1 heart) on solid ground, never over a pit. The oven-door handle is a long bar to run along; the knobs are 2-tile steps. Cockroaches run, then fly when startled: chirp-stun first, then kick. Floor continues left to the under-sink cabinet. The kick-plate under the cabinets is a dark crawlspace (Glow Bead) with a crumb cache.

### kit-counter: The Counter

Cell 12,6, 2x1 screens (64x18 tiles). Purpose: save, lairDoor, secret.

The counter run between the fridge top and the sink: a fruit bowl with a fruit-fly swarm (chirp to scatter), the bread bin. Save crack 2 by the sink and the "Ready?" card: the lair door (left edge, y 6). The upper cabinets are glass-fronted G 8 tiles above the counter: the Rubber Band reaches a seed-heart on top (teaser: you see it glint through the glass). From the fridge top, a 10-tile glide to the range hood finds a song-seed (Glider).

Cell 10,8, 2x1 screens (64x18 tiles). Purpose: item, soundHole, secret.

The cabinet under the sink: pipes, a U-bend, sponges, a leak puddle. The Bottle-Cap Raft sits in the puddle. ### kit-table: Under the Table

Cell 7,7, 3x2 screens (96x36 tiles). Purpose: sneak, shortcut.

Sneak section 1: darkling beetles plod a fixed loop along the floor under the table and chairs (unbeatable; 1 heart on contact). Hide under a napkin, a fallen crumb, a chair-leg cap (one within reach at every point; never timed). Chair seats are one-way platforms. Right side: the dishwasher. Its pulled-out rack is a ladder of one-way rungs on the west face; from its top you drop down the east side into the under-sink cabinet (one-way shortcut back east). The Cellophane Cloak lets you walk the beetle lane straight through (shortcut).

- sneak section: beetle (unbeatable; a hiding spot within reach everywhere; never timed)

## Boss: bigtok (distract)

Arena: room kit-sink, 2x2 screens. Fixed chirp: radius 4 tiles, stun 1 s (never from the cricket's stats). Tell: tail-tip wiggle + rattle-swish, 0.8 s (1.2 s in Gentle Mode); emit `game.emit('tell', {x, y})` when it starts. Losing restarts the current phase (restore health). Built for Jump 2 / Speed 2. Freed: duo.

Layout: 2x2: the counter (lower floor), the sink basin full of water (~, the Raft floats it), the backsplash tiles, Big Tok clinging to the wall above the faucet (tall frame), the spice rack high on the right wall with Duo stuck behind a jar. Three decoys sit along the counter edge.

- Phase 1: his "TO-KAY!" bellow sends a floor-level shockwave along the counter (jump it; 1 heart). He bites anything that moves on the counter. Kick the cork off the counter edge: he chomps it and his jaw is stuck for 5 s. Raft across the sink to the first spice-rack ledge. Ends: on ledge 1.
- Phase 2: two shockwaves per bellow (a short and a tall one). Kick the wooden spoon; raft to ledge 2. Ends: on ledge 2.
- Phase 3: the bellow also ripples the sink (the raft bobs: time your jump). Kick the sponge, raft and climb to the top of the spice rack, kick Duo's jar loose. Ends: rescue.

Hide spots: none.

Timings: tell 0.8, jawStuck 5, shockSpeed 9 tiles/s.

Props: cork, wooden-spoon, sponge, spice-rack, bottle-cap. Gecko art: sprites/geckos/bigtok/ (idle, strike, sleep, body, tail, legs + meta.json; renderer's gecko rig).

Lines: TEXT.geckos.bigtok.pre (3) before the fight, .post (2) after.
Recorded solution: design/solutions/zone-03-boss.json with the weakest crickets available at that point.
